results.content: With Election Day less than two weeks away, political polls released this week showed approval of President Donald Trump at another record low and that voters most likely to cast ballots strongly prefer Democrats. Only 36 percent of likely voters approved of Trump’s performance, and 59 percent said they disapproved, a poll from the New York Times and Siena University found, marking the president’s lowest approval rating recorded in that poll’s history. The results show a deepening frustration with the president over the economy, with a majority of voters disapproving of how Trump has handled the cost of living, the Iran war and gas prices.
